_meta.title: Titan Rulebook — canonical machine-readable line registry
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every licensed line. The SCANNER (pine/python) reads the 'scanner' fields to detect+display; the EXECUTION/APP (Titan Ops) reads 'execution','sizing','risk' to enforce at entry and manage. Human cards live in reports/PLAYBOOK.md; this file is what code consumes.
_meta.smart: Each rule is Specific (exact condition), Measurable (numeric thresholds + receipts), Achievable (backtest-validated), Relevant (licensed only), Time-bound (every exit has a clock: 50% target OR 21 DTE).

component_owners.scanner: detect entry trigger + gate state + habitat; DISPLAY only, no orders. Fields: market, entry, gate, habitat.
component_owners.execution: signal->order timing (D+1 9:30), structure, exits. Fields: structure, exits, entry_basis.
component_owners.risk: cluster tail-budget check BEFORE any add. Fields: cluster, references _CLUSTERS in worst-loss-reference.json.
component_owners.journal: record + grade adherence. Owned by Titan Ops app, not this file.

global.exit_default: take_profit_50 OR manage_21dte; NO price stops; NO trend-flip exit (curve-fit, killed OOS)
global.entry_basis: signal confirmed at day-D close; enter D+1 ~09:30 (validated D+1 basis)
global.note_risk_pct: Do NOT raise risk_pct. MAR peaks ~3% then falls; 2% is the disciplined setting.

scanner.gate: name-gate replaces VIX gate when VIX flat
